races.paceDynamic: Nakamura is the only confirmed front-runner in this field and should get an uncontested lead with the three other prominent runners (Joyful Tidings, Amiata, Chicago Pope) likely to settle just behind rather than challenge early. This creates a moderate pace scenario over 5f on soft ground, with the tempo sustainable rather than searching. The field splits into two clear camps - pace angles up front and hold-up horses (Michael's Well, Midnight Dusk, Shadow Run, Oh Cecelia) at the back. This setup moderately favours the prominent runners who can track the pace and kick - the hold-up horses face a tough task coming from too far back over this minimum trip.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Runners Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the pace stays controlled and the prominent trio can position perfectly behind Nakamura.
scenarios.body: The three quality horses tracking the leader (Joyful Tidings, Amiata, Chicago Pope) get first run on the field while the hold-up horses are caught too far back over the minimum trip. Colin Keane on Amiata and the in-form Oh Cecelia partnership become the key players.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If Nakamura goes too fast early or the prominent runners get into a speed duel.
scenarios.body: The pace collapses in the final furlong allowing the closers to sweep up from the back, with Oh Cecelia's recent Cork win and Michael's Well's class coming to the fore. The soft ground aids their late rally over this sharp 5f.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Nakamura Wires Field
scenarios.trigger: If Ben Coen can judge the fractions perfectly and Nakamura's dual 6f wins translate to sharp 5f speed.
scenarios.body: The front-runner gets away with soft fractions early then finds enough in the tank to repel all challengers, using his proven 6f speed effectively over this shorter trip. His two recent wins provide the confidence for aggressive tactics.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent runners hesitate and Nakamura stops quickly in the soft ground.
scenarios.body: The race falls apart tactically with no one wanting to commit early, turning into a messy sprint where any horse with a turn of foot can capitalize. Shadow Run's recent 5f second and Oh Cecelia's class could be decisive factors.

watchPoints.text: Oh Cecelia running again after just one day's rest following her Cork win - stamina reserves could be compromised despite her current form
Multiple trainers struggling for winners recently (Murtagh 0/18, Harty 0/6, O'Callaghan 0/5) - stable confidence may be low
First-time headgear applied to Shadow Run could spark improvement from this hold-up type who showed promise last time
Nakamura's front-running tactics obvious but watch early fractions - if he goes too fast the hold-up horses come into play
Three horses returning from 170+ day breaks (Joyful Tidings, Nakamura, Chicago Pope) - fitness questions despite workouts

races.paceDynamic: Cardiff By The Sea is the only confirmed front-runner and will dictate proceedings from the gates, likely getting an uncontested lead with the prominent runners Wearing Stars, Thenandnow, White Smoke, Fate's Gambit and Merry Blacksmith settling just behind. The sustainable pace will allow the field to stay bunched through halfway before quickening in the final two furlongs on this testing soft ground. This setup moderately favours prominent runners who can track the pace and kick - the hold-up horses face a tactical disadvantage with limited early pace to aim at.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Runners Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Cardiff By The Sea sets steady fractions and the prominent pack stays within striking distance
scenarios.body: The patient prominent runners get first run on the leader turning for home and have enough in reserve to sustain their challenge on the testing ground. White Smoke and Thenandnow benefit most from this tactical setup with their proven ability at the trip.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Runner Stays Strong
scenarios.trigger: If Cardiff By The Sea gets soft sectionals early and finds extra reserves when challenged
scenarios.body: The leader's class advantage tells as Seamie Heffernan times his effort perfectly, holding off late challenges with the benefit of an uncontested lead. The testing conditions suit his stamina reserves over pure speed.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold Up Challenge Succeeds
scenarios.trigger: If the pace quickens significantly from halfway and the early leaders weaken markedly
scenarios.body: The sustained gallop stretches the field and allows the patient hold-up horses to close strongly in the final furlong. Classical Symphony's high rating and Sparky Sparky's tactical flexibility give them the edge in this scenario.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Maiden Breakthrough
scenarios.trigger: If the experienced runners fail to handle the soft conditions or disappoint on return
scenarios.body: One of the less exposed three-year-olds shows significant improvement to win their maiden at the first attempt. Starman Tom or Cashel Blue benefit from lower weights and potential untapped ability.

White Smoke has best recent form ratings - watch for strong travelling position turning for home

races.paceDynamic: Wannabe Royal is the sole confirmed front-runner and will lead from the gates without early pressure, setting a controlled tempo through the first half. The prominent trio of Bucanero Fuerte, Powerful Nation, and Soldier's Tree will track the leader at comfortable striking distance, while the large contingent of hold-up horses including King Cuan, Thunderbear, and Unique Journey will settle towards the rear. With only one natural leader, the pace will be moderate rather than searching, allowing the field to stay compact into the straight. This setup strongly favours hold-up horses — the lack of pace pressure means they won't be inconvenienced by the soft ground and can unleash their finishing kicks from the back.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-up horses dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Wannabe Royal sets a steady tempo without early pressure
scenarios.body: The moderate pace allows the large group of closers to travel comfortably and unleash superior finishing kicks in the final two furlongs. The soft ground won't be an issue when they're not fighting a strong gallop.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent runners prevail
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is genuinely steady and prominent horses conserve energy
scenarios.body: Bucanero Fuerte and Powerful Nation can kick clear before the hold-up horses get organized, with their higher cruising speed proving decisive. The lack of early pace plays into their hands rather than the closers.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Wannabe Royal wire-to-wire
scenarios.trigger: If the leader meets the soft ground better than expected and no serious challenger emerges
scenarios.body: With no early pressure, Wannabe Royal can dictate terms throughout and prove hard to peg back despite his modest rating. The field's lack of early pace allows him to control the race completely.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace collapse benefits midfield
scenarios.trigger: If the early tempo is crawling and prominent horses get first run
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint finish where horses positioned in mid-division can strike first before the back-markers get into gear. Track position rather than finishing kick becomes crucial.

watchPoints.text: Watch if Wannabe Royal gets an uncontested lead as he could prove very hard to peg back despite his modest rating
Monitor the early pace as a crawling tempo would significantly disadvantage the hold-up horses who rely on a true gallop
Check market moves for King Cuan and Thunderbear as both have winning chances if their fitness is assured after lengthy breaks
Watch for Bucanero Fuerte to travel strongly in behind as his class could tell if he gets the right racing room
Keep an eye on Chicago Call's early positioning as the 3-year-old's weight allowance becomes more significant in a slowly-run race

races.paceDynamic: Wemightakedlongway is the lone confirmed pace-setter and won't face early pressure in this small field, allowing her to dictate a measured tempo over this stamina test. The prominent runners Elana Osario and It's A Heartbeat will track closely but are unlikely to challenge early on soft ground over 1m4f. With most of the field comprising hold-up horses including Magical Zoe and Snapretend, the pace will be sustainable rather than searching, creating a bunched field entering the straight. This setup strongly favours hold-up horses — the lack of pace pressure means the leaders won't soften up sufficiently, and closers will have every chance to produce their finishing kick.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Wemightakedlongway sets an uncontested lead and the pace stays moderate throughout
scenarios.body: The field stays bunched and the stronger finishers get first run on leaders who haven't been tested. Magical Zoe's class tells with Shane Foley timing her run perfectly, while Snapretend benefits from the patient ride her style demands.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Late Pace Injection
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is very slow and It's A Heartbeat or Elana Osario move to challenge Wemightakedlongway turning for home
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint finish where the horses with the best recent form and sharpness prevail. It's A Heartbeat's two recent wins give her the edge in a driving finish, with Snapretend's stamina kicking in late.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front End Holds On
scenarios.trigger: If Wemightakedlongway gets perfect fractions and the hold-up horses fail to produce their usual finishing kick on the testing ground
scenarios.body: The leader's stamina and Ryan Moore's tactical nous prove decisive as the soft ground blunts the closers' turn of foot. Wemightakedlongway stays on strongly with Elana Osario finishing best of the rest.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Upset Special
scenarios.trigger: If the market leaders fail to handle the conditions or bounce after their breaks
scenarios.body: The consistent Snapretend or an improving Moody takes advantage of the favorites' below-par efforts. Joseph O'Brien's double-handed approach with Snapretend proves shrewd as she relishes the extra distance.

watchPoints.text: Magical Zoe returning after 588 days - if she shows any ring-rustiness early or fails to travel smoothly, her chances diminish rapidly
Wemightakedlongway's stamina at 1m4f on soft ground - watch if she comes under pressure before the two-furlong pole
Moody's response to first encounter with soft going - her action and how she handles the kickback will reveal her suitability
It's A Heartbeat meeting soft ground for the first time - observe if she maintains her usual prominent position or struggles to keep up
The pace through the first half-mile - if exceptionally slow, it negates the hold-up horses' tactical advantage

races.paceDynamic: Perisher sits as the only confirmed front runner, but Felix Somary and Adel both show prominent tendencies and could press forward early, creating a competitive pace scenario. The soft going will test stamina reserves more than usual, potentially stretching out the field through the final two furlongs. With multiple hold-up horses including Invincible Will, Empty Wallet, Chapel Lane and Nod Of Approval carrying decent ratings, the pace dynamic looks set to favour those coming from off the pace. This setup strongly favours hold-up horses — the genuine pace and testing ground will create opportunities for closers with tactical speed.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-up horses dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is genuine with Perisher, Felix Somary and Adel all going forward
scenarios.body: The soft ground will sap the early leaders' stamina, creating perfect conditions for the hold-up brigade to sweep past in the final furlong. Invincible Will and Empty Wallet have the class and tactical speed to capitalise.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent horses persist
scenarios.trigger: If Felix Somary or Sunrise Angel can track the pace without over-racing
scenarios.body: Their superior fitness (Felix recent run, Sunrise returning trainer Andrew Slattery in form) allows them to sustain their effort when others tire on the testing ground. Felix Somary's winning form on similar going gives him the edge.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front runner steals it
scenarios.trigger: If Perisher gets an uncontested lead with the prominent horses settling further back
scenarios.body: Declan McDonogh can dictate fractions and kick for home before the hold-up horses get organised, with the 193-day break potentially providing freshness others lack. The lack of early pressure becomes crucial.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Outsider strikes
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses with early leaders going too slow or too fast
scenarios.body: A horse like Chapel Lane with hold-up style and solid RPR of 85 can time a late run perfectly when the market leaders have neutralised each other. W J Lee booking suggests stable confidence despite the long absence.
